notes:
I want to make it super clear. The recent work I've put out is a collaboration between myself and other extremely talented designers. The role "Design Engineer" can be confusing because it lives on a spectrum. It's not a one size fits all for every company. My role (and my perspective on it) is about implementing and then enhancing through that implementation. This means: • Handling interaction design • Supporting UX and UI decisions • Frontend engineering • Building APIs • Handling motion All with the goal of elevating the experience / vision. It does not mean handling all the visual design and brand work. I just want to make sure the credit goes to the right people. They deserve it. P.S. Hover on the cards on the Over-Stimulated site and you'll find the masters.

Designer: @willthomson__. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
